purpose: Teach: 大卒/常駐/還流/短絡/受話器/取り引き/改名/おもに

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、大卒に限らず広く人材を集められたぞ
lines.en: Your father had a gift for gathering talent — not just university graduates, but people from everywhere.
lines.style: Measured, slightly distant. A light fondness in the voice. Speaking from long memory, not lecturing. The cadence of someone recalling a quality he admired.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは支店に幹部を常駐させて運営された
lines.en: Yes. He stationed senior staff in the branches to run them himself.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Not answering back, but affirming what was said. Respectful rhythm. The voice of someone honoring both the memory and the listener.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、海外利益の還流をうまく活かされたぞ
lines.en: Your father made good use of overseas profits — he understood how to channel them back.
lines.style: Soft, reflective tone. A slight pause before speaking, as if reaching back in time. Warm regard underlining the words, not force.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは短絡的な経営をされなかった
lines.en: Yes. He never let short-term thinking drive the business.
lines.style: Steady, almost meditative. Each word weighted. Speaking with the quiet certainty of someone who watched it unfold. No rush.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、お得意様の受話器の声を大事にされたぞ
lines.en: Your father treasured the voice on the other end of the phone — his valued customers. He really listened.
lines.style: Tender beneath the formal delivery. A slight catch of warmth on 'treasured.' Speaking from genuine memory, not recitation. Eyes perhaps distant.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはお得意様との取り引きを生涯大切にされた
lines.en: Yes. He cherished his relationships with those clients — kept faith with them his whole life.
lines.style: Soft conviction. The rhythm of someone confirming something sacred. Not reverential, but genuinely moved. Slow, steady breath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社名改名の決断も慎重にされたぞ
lines.en: Your father was careful with every major decision — even something as big as changing the company name.
lines.style: Nostalgic, almost wry. A faint smile in the voice. The tone of someone who watched him deliberate, sometimes to excess. Affectionate recognition of a caution he valued.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはおもに国内事業に注力された
lines.en: Yes. He chose to stay focused on building the domestic business — that was where his strength lay.
lines.style: Calm, closing statement. A gentle certainty, like someone setting down the final piece. Warm but bounded. The voice settling, not questioning.
